question: In 2025, PM SVANidhi was enhanced with UPI-linked credit cards for street vendors. Which Ministry oversees this?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)** scheme was launched on **June 1, 2020** by the **Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA)** to provide affordable working capital loans to street vendors.
 
• In **2025**, the scheme was enhanced by linking **UPI-enabled digital credit cards** for street vendors, ensuring easier access to digital transactions and formal credit systems.
 
• The Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs is responsible for **urban development**, including schemes aimed at poverty alleviation and urban livelihood enhancement, which is why it oversees PM SVANidhi.
 
• The scheme is aimed at helping **street vendors**, a crucial part of the informal urban economy, to recover from the economic distress caused by the pandemic and ensure sustainable livelihoods.
 
• The **MoHUA** works in collaboration with banks, digital payment platforms, and municipalities to implement the scheme efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PM SVANidhi Scheme:**

 
 
• The scheme was launched during the COVID-19 pandemic to support **street vendors** by providing **collateral-free working capital loans** of up to Rs. 10,000 in the first phase.
 
• It encourages digital payments and offers **cashback incentives** for vendors who adopt online transactions.
 
• As of 2025, the scheme includes **UPI-linked credit cards**, providing vendors with access to instant credit for their operational needs.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA):**
 
 
• The MoHUA is responsible for urban housing, infrastructure, and poverty alleviation programs.
 
• The Ministry oversees flagship schemes like **Smart Cities Mission**, **AMRUT**, and **PMAY-Urban**.
 
• It plays a pivotal role in **urban development and providing livelihood support** to vulnerable sections of society.
 
 
 
• **UPI-Linked Credit Cards:**
 
 
• UPI-linked credit cards enable **real-time digital payments** and provide **access to formal credit systems** for small-scale vendors.
 
• This initiative promotes **financial inclusion** by bringing unbanked vendors into the formal economy.
 
• It also facilitates **digital literacy** and promotes transparency in financial transactions.
 
 
 
• **Role of Street Vendors in Urban Economy:**
 
 
• Street vendors contribute significantly to the **urban informal sector**, providing affordable goods and services to millions of people.
 
• They are among the most **vulnerable groups**, especially during economic disruptions like the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• Supporting street vendors ensures **economic resilience** and boosts overall urban economic activity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Ministries Mentioned in the Options:**

 
 
• **Ministry of Finance:** While it oversees financial policies and banking regulations, it does not directly handle urban livelihood schemes like PM SVANidhi.
 
• **Ministry of Commerce & Industry:** This Ministry focuses on trade and industry development, not urban housing or livelihood programs.
 
• **Ministry of MSME:** Though this Ministry supports micro, small, and medium enterprises, street vendors fall under the urban informal economy, managed by MoHUA.
